title: KAITO — It's All In The Mixing!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Anyone home?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, KAITO, it's you!
Welcome♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Luka, I didn't know you and the others were also here. I'm meeting with Len and...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, he's already here.
You'll find him at the table in the back.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thank you, Miku.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Would you like your usual drink?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes! As usual, the best coffee you can!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright, alright.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thank you for waiting, Len!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: KAITO, you're late!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Sorry about that. Still, it's very rare for you to pick a seat that's so far away from the counter.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
That's because...
I don't want the others to overhear us.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Why's that?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Cause it's about White Day and stuff, you know...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: White Day? Oh right, it is just around the corner!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Shh!
Don't talk so loud!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh? S-Sorry...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Should I be whispering instead...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I wanna make White Day special by putting on a little surprise for the others.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, good idea. We are entertainers, after all!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hm? Is something bothering you?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, that's why I asked you to meet me...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Haha. I see.
So, what's on your mind?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
The problem is...
I don't have a clue as to what to give everyone.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Rin and the others gave us stuff that they made themselves, so I was thinking about doing the same for them...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh, something homemade sounds nice!
That'll make it easier for you to show just how much you appreciate them.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, but that's easier said than done...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Okay, KAITO.
Here's your usual blend.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Thank you, Miku!
Mmm... As usual, a splendid aroma.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
That's great and all...
But what were you and Len talking about just now? It sounded sort of serious.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! You've had this worried expression on your face since coming here but kept saying that you're gonna talk to KAITO about it.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I'm your partner!
What happened to not hiding stuff from each other?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What she said!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Luka, don't jump on the bandwagon like that. That goes for you two as well, Rin, Miku. We should leave them to their business.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: More importantly, you're still going to try that new tea flavor for me, yes?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The kettle's just reached a boil, so why don't we get started?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: (Ah, MEIKO seems to have figured out that Len's here to discuss something with me...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
That was close, Len.
I'm glad they didn't learn about our surprise for them.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, do you have any other ideas in mind...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'll help you since Miku and Rin are already getting suspicious.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Also, I couldn't be happier that you're asking me for advice regarding this.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That means you're fully committed to helping me, right?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Alright, in terms of other ideas... I was thinking of an album of songs that mean a lot to them, but it seemed kinda regular...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Also...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Then, we'll try baking some cookies for them.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thanks for helping me with this, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Alright, I'm gonna ask MEIKO to see if we can borrow the kitchen!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Okay. Let's do our best to make our little surprise a good one!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah!
